messages:
eva: Kicked off the shadow->canary for v2-int4 this morning. Quick recap: P95 latency -10%, token-cost -18%, but long-doc ROUGE down ~3.6 pts and hallucination rate up from 0.6% -> 1.9%. Thoughts on auto-fallback thresholds? :thinking:

sam: Thanks — do we have slice-level breakdowns? suspect long-docs + code blocks.

eval-bot: SUMMARY: canary=5% shadow-run; metrics: lat_p95=180ms->162ms, token_cost=0.28->0.23, rouge_long=42.3->38.7, hallucination_rate=0.006->0.019. CI(95) computed.

alex: If hallucinations > 1.5% on safety slices then trigger immediate fallback. That's what we've used on previous int4 runs.

maria: Also seeing spike in error-rate on burst traffic from one DC (eu-west-1), likely different load shaping on tiny batches. Not a model quality issue but affects SLA.

eva: Good call. Proposing combined rule: if (hallucination_delta > +1.0pp AND rouge_long_drop >= 2.0) OR (slo_p95_regression > 8%) then rollback. Otherwise hold and run targeted evals for 6h.

sam: Can we make that granular? e.g. ignore small short-doc slice regressions, only act on long-form and safety-critical intents. Also require 2 consecutive windows (10m) to avoid noisy flips.

eva: Yup. Draft rollout snippet I pushed to infra config: ```
# rollout policy snippet
canary.percent = 5
canary.watch_slices = ["long_docs", "safety_queries"]
canary.rollback_if = (
  metric.hallucination_rate.delta >= 0.01 and metric.rouge_long.delta <= -2.0
) or (metric.lat_p95.delta >= 0.08)
canary.hysteresis.windows = 2
```

deploy-bot: canary start @2098765432 - route=eng-prod, percent=5, variant=v2-int4

eva: We'll run targeted evals (1000 long-doc prompts + safety prompts) — tagging @sam for dataset slices.

sam: prepping eval set now. Will also run reranker/penalty probe to see if calibration helps.

eval-bot: first eval window (10m) complete. Hallucination_rate=1.85% (p=0.48 vs baseline), rouge_long_drop=3.4 pts (p<0.01), lat_p95 improvement stable.

alex: Given rouge drop is significant and on long-doc slice, imo we should auto-fallback. Matches the rule.

maria: I'm +1 for fallback; also recommend draining canary traffic while we snapshot KV cache state to avoid cross-variant contamination.

eva: Ok initiating escape hatch: will cut canary to 0% and promote shadow back to 0.1x sampling. Will open a postmortem ticket for tuning quantization knobs. :rotating_light:

deploy-bot: rollback executed @2098765599 - canary_percent=0, variant_reverted=v1.4. Snapshot saved.

eva: Thanks all. Action items: 1) sam to run targeted calibration + reranker probe, 2) ml infra to add hysteresis window metric charts to canary dashboard, 3) gating team to consider lowering threshold to 0.8pp for hallucination in next run.

sam: Will try a hybrid quant (NF4+LSQ) in a sandbox, report by EOD.

eva: Filing ticket now — /ticket link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ML-3456. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
